description: Coded-reference retrieval set (Track C, task 10c protocol v4): public NTSB case numbers whose relevance is exact membership in each question's frozen code set (case_findings codes with explicit modifiers, case_sequence occurrence codes), aircraft attribution and filters, over every answer-eligible US case of the generation. Questions sharing a case, and paraphrases with their originals, are split together by group. Rebuild with pnpm eval:retrieval:coded.
caveat: Coded-reference labels: exact membership in each question's frozen code set over the answer-eligible cohort. Absence of a code is not a negative relevance judgement: uncoded cases are "not coded", neither credited nor penalised in recall, and precision is coded precision. These scores measure retrieval of coded facts, not adjudicated relevance.
